caption: The drawing depicts a wooden crucifix with a figure nailed to it. The cross consists of two wooden beams, one vertical and one horizontal, both rendered in shades of brown. At the top of the vertical beam, there is a small, rectangular sign with irregular edges, bearing the letters "INRI" in black. The figure is shown wearing a loincloth colored in yellowish tones with some shading, and a crown of thorns on the head, which is bent forward. The figure’s skin is a pale peach color, with red markings and blotches representing wounds or blood at various points, including on the hands, knees, feet, and side. The hands are nailed to the ends of the horizontal beam and the feet are nailed together on the vertical beam. The hair and beard of the figure are dark, and the expression is solemn. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or scenery present. There is a signature and date at the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Crucifix
